kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
نتباعد (form VI)
# نَتَبَاعَدُ (natabāʕadu) /na.ta.baː.ʕa.du/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَبَاعَدَ (tabāʕada)
# نَتَبَاعَدَ (natabāʕada) /na.ta.baː.ʕa.da/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَبَاعَدَ (tabāʕada)
# نَتَبَاعَدْ (natabāʕad) /na.ta.baː.ʕad/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَبَاعَدَ (tabāʕada)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
